title: maalc task options
description: What a task's entry action reads (agent/task_options.py, #776): the attach of GlobalOptions and of the task's entry node, as the client's global and task options write them (assets/interface.json). One $defs entry per node, by its name; each property's title is the interface.json option that writes it. Keys not here are left alone.

webhook_url.title: WebhookUrl
webhook_url.description: the stop procedure's webhook; empty: none

auto_accept_terms.title: AutoAcceptTerms
auto_accept_terms.description: tick both boxes of the title's User Agreement and Confirm; off: stop

auto_download.title: AutoDownload
auto_download.description: accept game data downloads and updates; off: stop

keep_dismissed_screens.title: KeepDismissedScreens
keep_dismissed_screens.description: save the screen to logs/dismissed/ before the bot closes a notice, popup, mailbox, settings menu, help page or parallel-mode prompt, or before recovery presses back

target_floor.title: MirrorTargetFloor
target_floor.description: 5 NORMAL/HARD, 10 INFINITY, 15 EXTREME; above 5 every floor of the run must be HARD (task_options.target_floor_errors)

runs_limited.title: MirrorRunsLimit
runs_limited.description: the task stops after runs runs; false: no limit

runs.title: MirrorRuns
runs.description: the runs that claim before the task stops; sent only while runs_limited is true

theme_pack_refresh.title: MirrorThemePackRefresh
theme_pack_refresh.description: free theme pack refreshes a floor may use while the best pack is below the plan's threshold

start_team.title: MirrorStartTeam
start_team.description: the team this task starts from: a teams[] id of the settings file, a case of the team options file the settings GUI writes (config/team_options.json, #805); its case 0, follow the team queue, sends nothing. Any type passes, as a value the agent cannot read (not a string, or empty) is following the queue too (task_options.options); a team deleted or disabled stops the task at its start (task_options.start_team_errors)

mode.title: ExpMode
mode.description: daily: the battles the day still needs, read on the pass's Daily row Clear EXP Luxcavation (1 while under way), none when it does not read (#429); count: count battles this run, nothing read (#431)

count.title: ExpCount
count.description: the battles to win this run; sent only while mode is count

retries.title: ExpRetries
retries.description: defeats of one battle fought again before the task fails; a win starts the next battle with them all

consecutive.title: ExpConsecutive
consecutive.description: set the stage's Consecutive Battle to min(10, battles left) and fight them as one battle (a x N win counts N); off: one battle at a time

team.title: ExpTeam
team.description: a teams[] id of the settings file: a case of the team options file the settings GUI writes (config/team_options.json, #780); not sent when none is picked, which task_options.team_errors stops on

mode.title: ThreadMode
mode.description: daily: the battles the day still needs, read on the Thread tab's Daily Bonuses (n/3 left: n), none when they do not read (#429); count: count battles this run, nothing read (#431)

count.title: ThreadCount
count.description: the battles to win this run; sent only while mode is count

retries.title: ThreadRetries
retries.description: defeats of one battle fought again before the task fails; a win starts the next battle with them all

consecutive.title: ThreadConsecutive
consecutive.description: set the card's Consecutive Battle to min(10, battles left) and fight them as one battle (a x N win counts N); off: one battle at a time

count.title: ChargeCount
count.description: the day's target Daily Count: charges made earlier today, by hand too, count toward it, and none is made once it is reached or when the Daily Count does not read (#429); 0: the Use Lunacy tab is never touched; the game allows 10 a day
